title: Query trace under availability identification
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\Omega$ be a set of coordinate values, and let $\alpha$ be a set of leaf labels. A finite decision tree queries available coordinates and branches according to their observed values. If $A$ and $B$ are equal sets of coordinates, then identifying a tree whose available set is $A$ as a tree whose available set is $B$ leaves its query trace unchanged on every input $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ and $B$ are equal finite sets of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
$T$ is a finite decision tree over $\Omega$ with leaf labels in $\alpha$ and available coordinates $A$
$x$ assigns a value in $\Omega$ to each coordinate
